items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: This critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows an unauthenticated attacker to escalate privileges by switching a customer session to another account. Exploitation requires no authentication or administrator privileges and has been observed in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could lead to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: This incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could lead to a security feature bypass. This issue was addressed in APSB26-49.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: This incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access. Exploitation requires no user interaction.

items.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
items.summary: A Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could lead to information disclosure. This vulnerability was resolved as part of APSB26-49.

items.title: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption Vulnerability
items.summary: This uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could lead to a denial-of-service. It was addressed in the APSB26-49 security update.

items.title: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption Vulnerability
items.summary: An uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in a denial-of-service. This issue was patched in APSB26-49.

items.title: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption Vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could lead to application denial-of-service. It was resolved with the release of APSB26-49.

items.title: Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.summary: A path traversal vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could allow an attacker to access sensitive files. This issue was addressed in APSB26-49.

items.title: Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.summary: This path traversal vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could lead to arbitrary file system read. It was resolved with the release of APSB26-49.
